title: Helios API overview
text: The Helios Payments API is a REST and JSON interface for card payments. All endpoints use the base URL https://api.helios.example/v1. The sandbox environment is separate from production and never moves real money.

title: Authentication and tokens
text: Helios uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Exchange the client id and secret for a bearer token that expires after 60 minutes. Requests with an expired or invalid token return HTTP 401 with error code invalid_token.

title: Rate limits
text: The Payments API rate limit is 600 requests per minute per client. A burst of 50 requests per second is allowed. When the limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header.

title: Idempotency keys
text: Send an Idempotency-Key header on every POST that creates a payment. Keys are retained for 24 hours. Replaying the same key returns the original response; reusing a key with a different payload returns HTTP 409.

title: Webhook signing and retries
text: Webhook payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the X-Helios-Signature header. Helios retries failed deliveries five times with exponential backoff. An endpoint must answer with a 2xx status within 10 seconds.

title: Error codes
text: Declined cards return HTTP 402 with error code card_declined. Insufficient funds use insufficient_funds, malformed requests use invalid_request, and temporary processor faults use processing_error.

title: Cursor pagination
text: List endpoints use cursor pagination and accept a limit parameter of at most 100 records. Pass starting_after with the last cursor to fetch the next page and stop when has_more is false.

title: Refund policy
text: A payment can be refunded in full or in part within 180 days. Refund objects move from pending to succeeded or failed. Partial refunds cannot exceed the captured amount.

title: Test mode and test cards
text: Use test card 4242424242424242 for successful payments. The card 4000000000000002 produces a declined payment. Test mode keys start with sk_test and are safe to commit to a local .env file.

title: Official SDKs
text: Official Helios SDKs exist for Python and Node.js. Both SDKs retry idempotent GET requests twice with jitter and raise a typed error for every documented error code.
